title: Inspect an offline RPM before admitting it
goal: Inspect trusted uninstalled RPM metadata, dependencies, payload modes and digests; distinguish internal integrity from publisher authenticity.
challenge: Inspect the three protected unsigned RPM archives, record their exact hashes, declared files/modes/owners, requirements and absence of scripts/triggers. Reject the supplied truncated private copy without installing it. Explain internal digest checking versus publisher authenticity; do not claim verified signatures or rpm2cpio practice.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/rpm-archive.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && umask 077; here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/rpm-archive.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700; }; fresh() { here || return 19; test "${1%/*}" = "$w" && test ! -e "$1" && test ! -L "$1"; }; cfg() { case "$1" in /etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmnew|/etc/learning-lab-rpm/report.conf.rpmsave) ;; *) return 19;; esac; here && test "$(realpath -e /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = /etc/learning-lab-rpm && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a /etc/learning-lab-rpm)" = root:root:755 && test -f "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(stat -c %U:%G:%a:%h "$1")" = root:root:644:1; }; keepcfg() { cfg "$1" && fresh "$w/$2" && cp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1; }; releasecfg() { cfg "$1" && test "${2##*/}" = "$2" && test -f "$w/$2" && test ! -L "$w/$2" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a:%h "$w/$2")" = learner:600:1 && cmp -- "$1" "$w/$2" && sudo rm -- "$1"; }; h=/usr/local/sbin/ll-rpm-fixture; f=/opt/learning-lab/rpm-fixtures; here && test "$(df -B1 --output=avail / | tail -1)" -ge 1073741824 && fresh "$w/before.json" && sudo "$h" status > before.json && grep -F '"fixtures": {}' before.json && fresh "$w/before-raw.tsv" && timeout -k 1s 20s sudo rpm -qa --qf '%{NAME}\t%{EPOCHNUM}\t%{VERSION}\t%{RELEASE}\t%{ARCH}\n' > before-raw.tsv && fresh "$w/before.tsv" && LC_ALL=C sort before-raw.tsv > before.tsv && pwd
steps.explanation: Record this private path and shell definitions. A guard failure stops the exercise; do not continue over existing fixtures. Resume requires recorded path/definitions, not replaying setup.
steps.expected: Fixture-free package baseline retained without masking query failure.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/archive-hashes.txt" && fresh "$w/metadata.txt" && fresh "$w/files.txt" && fresh "$w/requires.txt" && sha256sum "$f"/*.rpm > archive-hashes.txt && rpm -qpi "$f/ll-rpm-report-1.0-1.noarch.rpm" > metadata.txt && rpm -qpl "$f/ll-rpm-report-1.0-1.noarch.rpm" > files.txt && rpm -qpR "$f/ll-rpm-report-1.0-1.noarch.rpm" > requires.txt && cat archive-hashes.txt metadata.txt files.txt requires.txt
steps.explanation: Inspect only the three reviewed teaching archives. Compare whole-file hashes with the retained fixture manifest, not an arbitrary download. Source/specs are protected from ordinary users, not guest root.
steps.expected: Exact report dependency on data 2.0-1 and /usr/bin/sh; two declared ordinary files.

steps.command: here && fresh "$w/scripts.txt" && fresh "$w/triggers.txt" && rpm -qp --scripts "$f/ll-rpm-report-1.0-1.noarch.rpm" > scripts.txt && rpm -qp --triggers "$f/ll-rpm-report-1.0-1.noarch.rpm" > triggers.txt && test ! -s scripts.txt && test ! -s triggers.txt && rpm -qp --qf "[%{FILENAMES} %{FILEMODES:perms} %{FILEUSERNAME}:%{FILEGROUPNAME}\n]" "$f/ll-rpm-report-1.0-1.noarch.rpm"
steps.explanation: Read-only metadata inspection complements the retained build admission. Do not extract unknown RPMs or claim these queries safely sandbox arbitrary packages.
steps.expected: Root-owned 0755 report script and 0644 license; no scripts or triggers.

steps.command: rpm_step() { here || return 19; fresh "$w/signature.txt" || return 19; if rpm -K "$f/ll-rpm-report-1.0-1.noarch.rpm" > signature.txt 2>&1; then cat signature.txt && grep -F "digests OK" signature.txt; else return 1; fi; }; rpm_step
steps.explanation: The original project archive is intentionally unsigned. Digest validity detects internal damage, not publisher authenticity; official vendor authentication was performed in preparation, not this lesson.
steps.expected: Digest check succeeds; no signature-authentication claim.

steps.command: rpm_step() { here && fresh "$w/truncated-report.rpm" && fresh "$w/rejected.txt" && head -c 64 "$f/ll-rpm-report-1.0-1.noarch.rpm" > truncated-report.rpm || return 19; if rpm -K truncated-report.rpm > rejected.txt 2>&1; then return 1; else test $? -ne 0 && test -s rejected.txt && test "$(stat -c %s truncated-report.rpm)" = 64; fi; }; rpm_step
steps.explanation: Retain and reject a deliberately truncated private copy using read-only inspection. Never install it. A failed check detects this damage, not authenticity of the unsigned original.
steps.expected: Rejected 64-byte private candidate; protected original unchanged.

hints: Unsigned local fixture is not authenticated; rpm digest verification is not publisher trust; no scripts, links or unsafe extraction.
Read supported helper operations and the exact plan before APPLY. Unsigned fixture digests do not prove publisher authenticity.
Verify versions, payload/config bytes and actual learner access; package exit status alone is insufficient.
review: I retained the requested actual output, statuses, versions and byte/access evidence, including the incorrect case.
I met the selected mode’s outcomes and can explain the limitations. Completion records self-review, not a score or verified assessment.
I preserved originals and retained candidates, compared unrelated package state and completed only the exact cleanup.
coverage: LPIC-1 active v5.0 partial 102.5: uninstalled metadata, contents, requirements and digest inspection. Signature trust explained only; no rpm2cpio extraction, repository, YUM or Zypper practice. Self-reviewed, not automatic assessment.
